faqs.question: What is the Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) module?
faqs.answer: The M&E module is used to collect information about your business progress, programme experience, business performance, fund utilization, and other activities required for monitoring and evaluation.

faqs.question: Why do I need to complete M&E activities?
faqs.answer: M&E activities help TEF understand your business progress, programme impact, business performance, and entrepreneurial journey.

faqs.question: When will I receive a M&E survey?
faqs.answer: You may receive a M&E survey at different stages of the programme, depending on your programme status and applicable requirements.

faqs.question: Where can I access my assigned M&E surveys?
faqs.answer: You can access your assigned M&E surveys through the TEFConnect portal after they have been assigned to you. Only the drop- off survey will be sent specifically through email.

faqs.question: How will I know when a M&E survey is assigned to me?
faqs.answer: You may receive a notification through the TEFConnect portal and/or email when a survey is assigned to you.

faqs.question: Will I receive reminders before the survey deadline?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reminder notifications and emails may be sent before the survey deadline.

faqs.question: What is a Baseline Survey?
faqs.answer: The Baseline Survey collects information about your business when you are enrolled in the programme.

faqs.question: What is a Midline Survey?
faqs.answer: The Midline Survey measures your business progress after the specified period following the Baseline Survey.

faqs.question: What is an Endline Survey?
faqs.answer: The Endline Survey is conducted after funding to evaluate your business outcomes.

faqs.question: What is a Business Performance Survey?
faqs.answer: The Business Performance Survey collects information about your business performance and growth when it is assigned to you.

faqs.question: What is a Drop-off Survey?
faqs.answer: A Drop-off Survey is provided when you have not completed required programme activities within the applicable timeline and have been marked as dropped off from the programme. It collects feedback about the reason for non-completion.

faqs.question: Why have I received a Drop-off Survey?
faqs.answer: You may have received a Drop-off Survey because a mandatory programme activity was not completed within the specified timeline.

faqs.question: How do I complete an assigned M&E survey?
faqs.answer: Open the assigned survey through the portal or notification, answer all required questions, upload supporting documents where required, provide the required consent, and submit the survey.

faqs.question: Can I save my M&E survey and complete it later?
faqs.answer: No, you need to complete it at once.

faqs.question: What information do I need to provide in an M&E survey?
faqs.answer: You need to provide the information requested in the assigned survey and complete all mandatory questions.

faqs.question: Can I upload supporting documents with my survey?
faqs.answer: Yes. Some survey questions may require supporting documents to be uploaded.

faqs.question: What documents do I need to upload?
faqs.answer: The required documents depend on the survey and the information being requested. Upload the supporting documents specified in the survey.

faqs.question: Why do I need to upload supporting documents?
faqs.answer: Supporting documents help validate the information provided in your survey responses.

faqs.question: Can I submit my survey without uploading required documents?
faqs.answer: No. If supporting documents are marked as required, they must be uploaded before you can submit the survey.

faqs.question: Is providing consent mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Required consent must be provided before you can submit the survey.

faqs.question: Why do I need to provide consent?
faqs.answer: Your consent allows TEF to use the information you submit for monitoring and evaluation purposes.

faqs.question: How do I submit my M&E survey?
faqs.answer: Complete all mandatory questions, upload the required supporting documents, provide the required consent, and click Submit.

faqs.question: Can I edit my survey after submission?
faqs.answer: No. Submitted M&E surveys cannot be edited.

faqs.question: Can I change my survey answers after submitting the survey?
faqs.answer: No. You cannot change your answers after the survey has been submitted.

faqs.question: What happens after I submit my survey?
faqs.answer: Your submitted survey is processed as part of the M&E process. You do not need to take any further action unless the platform or programme team asks you to do so.

faqs.question: Can my M&E survey be approved or rejected?
faqs.answer: The current M&E process does not describe an entrepreneur-submitted survey as being approved or rejected.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss the survey deadline?
faqs.answer: You cannot complete the survey once the deadline has passed.

faqs.question: Can I complete a M&E survey after the deadline?
faqs.answer: No. The survey cannot be completed once the specified deadline has passed.

faqs.question: What happens if I do not complete an assigned M&E survey?
faqs.answer: It is not mandatory to take the survey; however, it helps understanding the platform about your business and experiences.

faqs.question: How do I know whether my M&E activity is complete?
faqs.answer: Check the relevant survey or activity status on the TEFConnect portal. If the status does not reflect your completed submission, use the available support option.

faqs.question: Why can’t I access my assigned survey?
faqs.answer: Make sure the survey has been assigned to you and is still within its active timeline. If the issue continues, use the available support option.

faqs.question: What should I do if I have not received my assigned survey?
faqs.answer: Check your TEFConnect notifications and email. If the survey should have been assigned to you but is not available, use the available support option.

faqs.question: What should I do if I do not understand a survey question?
faqs.answer: Review the question and any instructions provided with the survey. If you still need clarification, use the available support option.

faqs.question: What is physical verification?
faqs.answer: Physical verification is a M&E activity in which an enumerator verifies your business information, collects the required evidence, and completes the applicable verification activity.

faqs.question: Why has an enumerator been assigned to me?
faqs.answer: An enumerator may be assigned to conduct physical verification as part of the M&E process.

faqs.question: How will I know about my verification visit?
faqs.answer: The enumerator will coordinate the verification visit with you and provide the scheduled date, time, and location.

faqs.question: What should I prepare for a verification visit?
faqs.answer: Keep the requested business information and supporting documents ready for verification.

faqs.question: What happens during a verification visit?
faqs.answer: The enumerator verifies your business information, collects the required evidence, and completes the applicable verification activity.

faqs.question: What is the Fund Use Assessment?
faqs.answer: The Fund Use Assessment collects information about how programme funds have been utilized.

faqs.question: When does the Fund Use Assessment become available?
faqs.answer: The Fund Use Assessment becomes available when you reach the applicable Alumni stage of the programme.

faqs.question: Are receipts mandatory for the Fund Use Assessment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Receipt upload is mandatory when completing the Fund Use Assessment.

faqs.question: What should I upload for the Fund Use Assessment?
faqs.answer: You should upload the required receipts and any other information or documents requested as part of the Fund Use Assessment.

faqs.question: Can I edit my Fund Use Assessment after submission?
faqs.answer: No, once submitted it cannot edited.

faqs.question: What is a Success Story?
faqs.answer: A Success Story allows you to share your entrepreneurial achievements using text, images, and videos.

faqs.question: Where do I submit my Success Story?
faqs.answer: You can submit your Success Story through the Alumni Community module using the dedicated Success Story form.

faqs.question: Can I upload images or videos with my Success Story?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can include text, images, and videos as part of your Success Story submission.

faqs.question: Can I edit my Success Story after submission?
faqs.answer: No. A submitted Success Story cannot be edited. If it is rejected, you can resubmit it as applicable.

faqs.question: How do I know if my Success Story has been reviewed?
faqs.answer: You can view the updated status of your Success Story after it has been reviewed.

faqs.question: What should I do if I cannot upload a supporting document?
faqs.answer: Verify that the file meets the required format and try uploading it again. If the issue continues, use the available support option.

faqs.question: What should I do if I cannot submit my survey?
faqs.answer: Ensure that all mandatory questions have been answered, required documents have been uploaded, and the required consent has been provided before submitting.

faqs.question: What should I do if the survey page is not loading?
faqs.answer: Refresh the page, check your internet connection, and try again. If the issue persists, use the available support option.

faqs.question: How can I report an issue with the M&E module?
faqs.answer: Use the support option available on the platform or contact TEF support for assistance with technical issues.
